objective: Give the monetization section of the Cash page the ledger decisions the server implements and no client calls: naming a possibility (SEED), recording a relation between two (LINK — the only writer of a blocking edge), merging, un-merging and splitting, and the two-path comparison. The routes are POST /api/projects/:projectId/cash/monetization/paths (server/routes/cash.ts ~1832-1870, `seedPath`, method from MONETIZATION_METHODS in server/domain/types.ts ~9347), POST /api/cash/monetization/paths/:pathId/lineage (~1928-2028, action MERGE {into, reason} / UNMERGE / SPLIT {into:[{method,title?,thesis?}], reason} / LINK {kind, to, rationale} with kind from MONETIZATION_EDGE_KINDS ~9494) and GET /api/projects/:projectId/cash/monetization/compare?a=&b= (~1652-1690). client/src/lib/cashApi.ts already has `whyRanked` (~533-550) and `seedPath` (~639-646) with no caller anywhere in client/src, and has no lineage function at all; client/src/russell/Cash.tsx's `Monetization` (~3165-3435), `PathDetail` (~3512) and `PathJudgment` (~3722) call only pathDetail and judgePath. CLAUDE.md §49 records that a recorded edge is what makes a possibility BLOCKED and that for a while nothing could write one; the route now exists and the product still cannot reach it.
expectedOutcome: CashApi gains `pathLineage(pathId, body)` for the four lineage actions; `whyRanked` and `seedPath` gain callers. Inside the existing monetization section (FULL scope, gated on `page.capabilities.mayActOnJob` like `PathJudgment`): a **Name a possibility** form (method chosen from a closed list the page already holds or the server sends, optional thesis, attached to the opportunity it is shown under); per path, **Record a relation** (kind chosen from the eight edge kinds, the other path chosen from the ledger's own entries, rationale required), **Merge into…** (survivor chosen from the ledger, reason required), **Un-merge** on a merged path, and **Split** (one or more methods, reason required); and a **Compare with…** control that calls whyRanked with b and renders the server's comparison sentences. Every refusal is rendered in the server's words, every success re-reads the page, and relations shown in PathDetail name who recorded them. Nothing is deleted and no possibility disappears from *All monetization paths* because of any of these decisions.
nonGoals: Changing seedPath, linkPaths, mergePaths, unmergePath, splitPath, the rank, the status derivation or any service in server/services/cash/monetization/**.
Any control that answers a Brain-owned attribute: no person-answer form for a ledger fact, a price, a payer or any of the thirteen attributes (§49, §33).
Any probability, percentage, score or confidence figure anywhere in the new controls.
A delete, a hide or any control that removes a possibility, a relation or a judgement.
Adding a route, a column or a migration.
Offering any of these controls, or the compare result's money-bearing sentences, to a SHARED-scope reader.

acceptanceConditions.statement: A test drives the Cash section over the real routes and database: recording a REQUIRES relation between two live paths writes one monetization_path_edges row with the rationale and the person as decided_by_id, and the dependent path's status on the next read is BLOCKED.

Naming a possibility through the new form writes a SEED-origin monetization_paths row for the chosen method; naming the same method again for the same discovery creates no second row and renders the server's 'already in the ledger' message.

Merging a path into another sets its merged_into_id, un-merging clears it, and splitting leaves the parent row unchanged while creating children that name it; after each the parent, the child and the absorbed path are all still listed under All monetization paths.

Compare with another path renders the comparison the compare route returns and makes no write: a test asserts the row counts of monetization_paths, monetization_path_edges and monetization_path_judgments are unchanged by it.
No new control renders an input for any monetization attribute value, and no rendered text in the new controls contains a percent sign or the word probability, asserted against the rendered document.

A SHARED-scope member's page renders none of the new controls, and a WORKER principal posting to the paths or lineage route is refused with no row changed; request bodies carry only the fields each lineage action reads.
The existing tests/cashSection.test.tsx, tests/monetizationLedger.test.ts and tests/monetizationCommissioning.test.ts still pass and the repository typechecks.

rollbackRequirement: Discard the branch. Client and test changes only; every decision the new controls record is reversible through the same existing routes (unmerge, a later relation, a later judgement) and nothing is deleted.
